# truenas_nvmet_host_subsys (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS NVMe-oF host/subsystem association by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric NVMe-oF host/subsystem association ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `host_id` (Number) ID of the NVMe-oF host.
- `subsys_id` (Number) ID of the NVMe-oF subsystem.
